summary_en: Compares ZW800-1 with indocyanine green for dynamic contrast-enhanced photoacoustic imaging. Phantom and orthotopic breast-tumor experiments show that ZW800-1 provides a greater dynamic range for assessing treatment-induced changes in tumor vascular perfusion.

summary_en: Combines particle-resolved simulations with point-particle modeling to study photoacoustic responses from polystyrene bead suspensions in water. It explains how residual acoustic pressure scales with the effective number of irradiated particles and may inform photoacoustic sensing for microplastics and microfluidics.
